parameters.name: ArtifactType
parameters.description:
The type of the artifact.

*   `ACCELERATED_IMAGE`: accelerated images.

parameters.name: BuildRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the artifact building rule.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Container Registry instance.

parameters.name: ScopeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the effective range of the artifact building rule.

*   Set the value to the ID of the image repository.

parameters.name: ScopeType
parameters.description:
The effective range of the artifact building rule. Valid values:

*   `REPOSITORY`: The artifact building rule is effective in the repository level.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr get-artifact-build-rule --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --scope-type REPOSITORY --scope-id crr-8dz3aedjqlmk0000 --artifact-type ACCELERATED_IMAGE --build-rule-id crabr-o2670wqz2n700000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr GetArtifactBuildRule --region cn-hangzhou --ScopeType REPOSITORY --BuildRuleId 'crabr-o2670wqz2n700000' --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --ArtifactType ACCELERATED_IMAGE --ScopeId 'crr-8dz3aedjqlmk0000'
